name: Kurebayashi Hotaru
source: Once a promising tennis player in her student days, she was forced to retire due to injury. Now, she works as an instructor at the hotel’s fitness gym. Her cool beauty and polite demeanor make her highly popular. With a reserved, quiet aura and few words, she can come across as unapproachable.
